papers.title: Quasinormal-mode stability bounds in gravitational EFT: resolvability, predictivity, and positivity
papers.abstract_summary_en: The authors examine a proposed black-hole ringdown damping-time stability bound in gravitational effective field theories. They argue that under ordinary one-scale power counting the would-be violation emerges only as higher-derivative corrections lose predictivity, while resolvable exceptions require unusual coefficient patterns or two-scale EFTs.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文评估‘EFT修正不应让黑洞某个QNM衰减时间延长超过约一个振荡周期’的准正常模稳定性猜想，指出标准一尺度EFT下可见偏差与无限高阶算符同阶，从而该界一般不给出超越既有positivity bounds的新限制。

papers.title: Closure of Traceful Radiation-Gauge Reconstruction with Matter: General Kerr Conditions, a Thin-Shell Benchmark, and a Conserved Torus
papers.abstract_summary_en: For first-order Kerr perturbations with matter, the metric reconstruction requires radiative curvature, source-driven Ricci/trace components and non-radiative mass/angular-momentum completion. The work proves a local transport-hierarchy result under compatibility assumptions and formulates conditional global requirements, illustrating them with a thin shell and a conserved torus.

papers.title: Can a Wormhole Induce a Monopole?
papers.abstract_summary_en: An orbiting source beyond a wormhole mouth cannot induce the periodically changing observer-side mass monopole claimed from sequentially matched static geometries. Electromagnetic flux conservation, linearized vacuum Einstein equations and the vacuum Bondi balance restrict the true evolution; higher multipoles are not excluded.

papers.title: Analytic Bootstrap Solution for Quantum Mechanics on a Circle
papers.abstract_summary_en: The authors solve the moment-recursion bootstrap for a particle on a circle by enforcing exponentially decaying Fourier moments. papers.title: Cosmology of the Baby Universe in Coupled SYK
papers.abstract_summary_en: Finite-N and finite-p Majorana trace combinatorics extend the chord description of a closed baby universe arising in coupled SYK. A heavy insertion creates a first-order transition between thermal AdS and a baby-universe saddle. A proposed interior-time prescription yields a cosine-type expansion and recollapse.

papers.title: Can One Hear the Absence of a Singularity?
papers.abstract_summary_en: Large-overtone QNM monodromies for regular black holes differ discontinuously from Schwarzschild as core size tends to zero.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 规则黑洞在特定高泛音和扰动模型下实部频率趋零；核心正则化与无限泛音极限不对易，可观测常规ringdown不能直接推得该结果。
papers.body_sections: main text WKB/monodromy, numerical Fan–Wang/Bardeen, Discussion; SM.1–SM.5 key formulas, Stokes connectivity (1–3, 6, 8, 13, 15, 17–18, 81)

papers.title: Another Brick in the Wall: Spectral Form Factor of Normal Modes in Horizonless Geometries
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：无视界几何的正常模谱形状因子可能出现ramp，警惕把谱统计当作黑洞混沌或视界证明。

papers.title: Genesis in Minimally Modified Gravity
papers.abstract_summary_en: A minimally modified gravity model is used to construct a Genesis cosmology asymptoting to Minkowski spacetime in the past. The background is past geodesically complete with ordinary NEC-satisfying scalar matter, while perturbation stability and cubic interaction scales are analyzed conditionally.
papers.authors: Alexander Ganz; Paul Martens; Shinji Mukohyama; Pavel Petrov
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用VCDM型最小修改引力，在过去渐近Minkowski且测地完备的宇宙学背景中实现Hubble增长，普通标量物质仍满足NEC；作者分析标量/张量扰动谱、有限IR梯度负声速区以及三次作用的强耦合尺度。

papers.title: Scattering amplitudes from geometry of kernel-free functionals on piecewise random null paths with memory
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：随机分段null路径的速度记忆参与振幅几何构造；这里memory不是引力记忆，需要检验方法迁移。

papers.title: On 2-loop AdS₂ superstring partition function in AdS₅ × S⁵ and AdS₄ × CP³
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：AdS₂弦世界面二圈配分函数的测度/正则化与全息Wilson环，和AdS₂量子边界计算相关但非JT。

papers.title: The Disordered Universe 2025: Features in a Λ>0 Universe
papers.abstract_summary_en: The lecture notes survey de Sitter causal patches, representation theory and scalar QFT, canonical quantum gravity and observables in finite gravitational regions, emphasizing the role of quasi-local boundaries and observer-dependent access to cosmological information.
papers.authors: Lecturer Dionysios Anninos; notes Samuel Brian, Yakov Landau, Tommaso Marini, Daniel McLoughlin, Polina Petriakova, Rajat Sharma; editors Paolo Benincasa, Guilherme Leite Pimentel
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 讲义从de Sitter的因果区、群表示和量子场论讲到Wheeler–DeWitt量子引力，尤其强调宇宙学缺乏通常的无穷远散射边界，因此物理观测量可以依托有限观察者世界管和准局域边界条件。

papers.title: The Disordered Universe 2025: An Intro and a Vision
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：无序宇宙学研讨导论串联振幅、开放系统和自旋玻璃，跨方法概览值得核查。

papers.title: Spin generalizations of the classical elliptic Calogero--Inozemtsev model and integrable models of interacting tops associated with the BC_n root system
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：BC_n Calogero–Inozemtsev Lax对和Yang–Baxter/反射矩阵，可能用于可积系统学习。

papers.title: Thermodynamics and phase structure of rotating Hayward-AdS black holes
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：旋转Hayward–AdS黑洞无约束热力学相空间及多支相变，邻近热力学而非当前模型。

papers.title: Two types of hairy black holes in the (3+1)-dimensional O(3) sigma-model
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：O(3)非线性sigma模型黑洞毛发分支与全局荷；标量和边界条件对照可能有用。

papers.title: On-shell reduction of spin-zero Duffin-Kemmer-Petiau covariants and implications for the relativistic impulse approximation
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：DKP协变量在壳约化至两独立散射振幅，适合QFT壳上等价方法练习。

papers.title: Noether Symmetries in Scalar--Vector--Two-Form Cosmology with a Topological BF Interaction
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：标量-矢量-二形式BF作用量中保留lapse并用Noether对称约化，约束处理技术可迁移。

papers.title: Cosmic-string calorimetry with a 220 PeV neutrino
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：220 PeV中微子估计宇宙弦网络向粒子辐射的能量预算，偏具体粒子天体约束，无当前引力边界方法。

papers.title: MPS overlaps and Sklyanin determinants
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：可积MPS重叠函数由Sklyanin行列式及Gaudin行列式求出，对量子多体方法有潜在作用。

papers.title: On the geometric origin of central charges in gravity
papers.abstract_summary_en: An ambiguity-free covariant phase-space framework yields charge representation theorems when the Noetherian flux vanishes or is integrable. The central extension follows from the Lagrangian and associated geometric data. AdS3 boundary conditions provide an explicit application.

papers.title: Nonradial oscillation modes of axion condensed neutron stars in the Cowling approximation
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：轴子凝聚中子星的Cowling近似非径向模和衰减时间，偏核天体的模式预报。

papers.title: Geodesic dynamics and tidal forces in a quantum-regularized black hole from string T-duality
papers.abstract_summary_en: The paper analyzes how a finite T-duality length and electric charge alter horizon configurations, test-particle effective potentials and tidal stretching/compression. It reports bounded central tidal forces and condition-dependent geodesic-deviation behavior.
papers.authors: G. Alencar; Micael S. Oliveira; Diego Sáez-Chillón Gómez; Marcos V. de S. Silva
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对T-duality启发的中性、带电静态规则解，研究正则化长度与电荷如何改变视界、测地圆轨、自由落体潮汐及相邻测地线偏离；规则核心使潮汐量有界。

papers.title: Covariant Wigner function and spin polarization of the Rarita-Schwinger field
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：Rarita–Schwinger场的协变Wigner函数和伪规范自旋极化，场论形式值得注意。

papers.title: Cosmological constraints on single-field inflation models from ACT/SPT data and observations at sub-Mpc scales
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：ACT/SPT与多尺度宇宙学数据约束单场暴涨势及PBH/PTA信号，无直接边界荷/时钟或可复用工具。

papers.title: Probing the inner disk edge of rotating neutron stars with dipole excitations in finite nuclei
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：中子星核电偶极极化率限制吸积盘内缘轨道频率，属核状态方程与天体观测专门问题。

papers.title: Entanglement Bounds on Cardy Growth in Higher Dimensions
papers.abstract_summary_en: The authors propose inequalities linking thermal entropy coefficients to universal entanglement data in three- and four-dimensional unitary conformal field theories. They present a stronger conjectural stress-tensor bound and controlled checks in weak coupling, large-N, holography and finite-N numerical examples.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出高维CFT热熵/高能Cardy增长系数由球面纠缠相关的普适量约束：四维f不超过4π²a，三维f不超过约2.99830949 F，并讨论与应力张量三点函数有关的更强猜想及多类验证。

papers.title: Exact TbarT-Like flows in Integrable Sigma Models
papers.abstract_summary_en: For one-scale integrable sigma-model families satisfying the Courant–Hilbert condition, exact irrelevant flows can be expressed using stress-tensor invariants. The analysis includes generalized Born–Infeld, power-law, logarithmic families, dimensional extensions and a commuting root-type deformation.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 文章在Courant–Hilbert可积约束下，对一尺度可积sigma模型构造依赖应力张量二次不变量的精确无关形变方程，并以GBI、q变形、对数等族展示正规参数范围、分支点和与root-TbarT流的对易性。

papers.title: Rank reduction in orthosymplectic types
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：正交辛超Yangian秩降低与R矩阵归一化，或助于可积模型代数，但目前科研关联未确立。

papers.title: Recovering classical gauge geometry from quantum master constraints
papers.abstract_summary_en: For a Morse–Bott nonnegative master constraint the linearized Hamiltonian flow has image equal to the symplectic normal of its zero set; first-class/coisotropic geometry is diagnosed by nilpotence of the linearization. Semiclassical fluctuation observables and harmonic spectral offsets recover the characteristic distribution in oscillator and SL(2,R) examples, subject to explicitly stated regularity conditions.

papers.title: Quasinormal Ringing of a Schwarzschild Black Hole Surrounded by a King Dark Matter Halo: Higher-Order WKB Analysis
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：暗物质晕修正QNM势和高阶WKB及时间域验证，谱方法可借用于黑洞分析。

papers.title: Recovering the leading quantum correction to Newton Potential beyond the Trace Anomaly
papers.abstract_summary_en: The work compares the large-distance semiclassical gravitational potential generated by the trace-anomaly sector with a fuller approximate Boulware stress tensor. Vacuum polarization supplies the leading one-loop radial scaling, whereas the anomaly coefficient enters at higher inverse powers.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 单靠四维迹反常的有效作用不能产生牛顿势的一圈1/r³主导修正；加入Boulware真空极化近似应力张量可以恢复正确幂次，但数值系数需借助已有一圈结果匹配。

papers.title: One Method to Find Them All: Analytic Black Holes beyond Einstein
papers.abstract_summary_en: A unified stationary axisymmetric method reconstructs Kerr deformations from curvature and physical sources. At leading order in six higher-curvature couplings, the authors exhibit closed analytic solutions for arbitrary subextremal spin and compare horizon and observational properties.
papers.authors: Dongjun Li; Jierui Hu; Nicolás Yunes
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者提出从Weyl曲率与源张量恢复Kerr度规偏离的解析方法，并在六种高阶曲率相互作用的耦合常数首阶、任意次极端旋转参数范围内求出无需慢旋转展开的解析解。

papers.title: Gravitational wave signatures of periodic orbits around a Schwarzschild-like black hole
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：Schwarzschild型黑洞周期轨道及四极引力波数值重建，较接近轨道教学例子。

papers.title: Reflected constraint algebras of open Carroll--Weyl null strings
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：开放Carroll–Weyl null string的反射约束代数与边界荷，辛/约束方法可直接借鉴。

papers.title: Meet-in-the-Middle Compilation of the [CNOT] Class with Fibonacci Anyons
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：Fibonacci任意子量子门编译的GPU braid搜索与误差界，偏量子计算编译，暂无AdS₂/引力相关工具。

papers.title: Resurgence of Black Holes in Thermal OPE
papers.abstract_summary_en: Holographic thermal OPE resurgence: Borel singularity locations are classical WKB saddle actions; full retarded response is reconstructed only in a specified frequency wedge.
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 热OPE大阶系数的Borel奇点与AdS黑洞复径向路径相连，部分路径触及奇点；完整retarded函数的Borel重建有明确复频角域条件。
papers.body_sections: I–V, including (2), (11)–(19), (21–22), (24–27), (34–35), (37–39); supplementary methods located, not recomputed

papers.title: A Spin on Radiation Reaction with Cuts
papers.abstract_summary_en: The authors derive electromagnetic radiation-reaction dynamics for a charged spinning particle through quadratic spin order and compare a regularized classical self-field calculation with a one-loop on-shell Compton-cut waveform computation.
papers.authors: Asaad Elkhidir; Matteo Sergola; Pablo Vives Matasan
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者将带自旋电荷粒子的Abraham–Lorentz–Dirac反作用推广至自旋平方阶，经典方法通过世界线自场与维数正规化求解，散射振幅方法通过Compton单圈割计算耗散波形，并核查两种方法一致。

papers.title: Stability of Axion--SU(2) Chromomagnetic Condensates with Stochastic Spin-2 Dressing
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：随机自旋2背景修正axion-SU(2)凝聚态能隙稳定性，均场/非高斯涨落方法可迁移。

papers.title: A Quiet Night in the Millihertz Sky? LISA Forecasts from LIGO/Virgo/KAGRA Populations
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：LISA探测数由GWTC-5.0黑洞种群后验外推，偏天体统计预报而非现有引力理论推导。

papers.title: Weighing dark matter particles with gravitational waves
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于官方完整摘要的预分类要点：用EMRI波形推断超轻暗物质粒子质量及密度尖峰，偏观测参数估计与天体环境。

papers.title: The 't Hooft model on (A)dS₂
papers.abstract_summary_en: Large-N two-dimensional QCD is solved on fixed AdS2 and dS2 using a null gauge and an affine light-front coordinate. The SL(2,R) Casimir adds a curvature-dependent Legendre operator to the meson equation; the AdS spectrum and de Sitter resonances, boundary sectors, and chiral limits are explored.
